relationships.subject: Nav1.7 L858H
relationships.evidence_quote: the L858H mutation of Nav1.7 within DRG neurons, functionally introduced at physiological levels, lowered the rheobase and increased AP firing probability

relationships.subject: Nav1.8
relationships.evidence_quote: Nav1.8 channel amplifies excitability at a broad range of membrane voltages with a predominant effect close to the AP voltage threshold

relationships.subject: Nav1.8
relationships.evidence_quote: demonstrate a profound functional interaction of Nav1.8 with Nav1.7 close to the threshold for AP generation

key_findings: Nav1.8 open probability exceeds Nav1.7WT ninefold at AP voltage threshold; Nav1.7 dominates near resting potential.
Dynamic-clamp reduction of Nav1.8 conductance by 25-50% reverses hyperexcitability of DRG neurons expressing Nav1.7 L858H.
